title: 第198章 狗咬狗第197章 宝藏开启
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 枯井之上。
“妈的，连续几天几夜赶到东土，现在他们在下面拿宝贝，咱们在上头喝西北风。”一个络腮胡大汉骂骂咧咧，愤怒的把刀往地上一插：“老子现在火气很大啊！”
另外一个国字脸男子好笑道：“人家是武尊，肯定有资格进去。”
“我们就是拿固定供奉的，有的吃就不错了。”
络腮胡大汉站起来，目光在叶家一群女眷身上扫过：“反正闲着也是闲着，老子先泄泄火……”
目光锁定叶薇妮！
她身材高挑，皮肤白皙，娇躯丰满，一张俏脸更是不输青楼花魁。
插起来肯定舒服！
叶薇妮下意识往叶傅身后躲。
叶傅拄着拐杖挡在前面，声音沙哑：“你们想干什么？”
“滚开！”
络腮胡大汉抓住叶傅肩膀，直接摔出去。
“爷爷！”
叶薇妮想过去搀扶，却被络腮胡大汉一把扣住肩膀，刚要行不轨之事。
身后传来一道冰冷的声音：“你在干什么？”
络腮胡大汉一激灵，回头一看，立刻露出一抹谄媚的笑容：“张老，原来是您啊，您怎么上来了？”
张老冷声道：“二爷有令！下面的东西太多，让你们一起下去搬！”
“叶家的人，防止他们逃跑，一起带进来！”
十一名武宗顿时大喜。
“哈哈哈！我就说二爷不会忘了咱们！”
络腮胡大汉强压着邪火，押着叶家一百多人，跳进枯井。
当叶家众人穿过石门，看到宝库内的真面目时，所有人惊的站在原地。
无数丹药、灵石、附魔武器、魔兽晶核、各种等级的武技，眼花缭乱。
一片倒吸凉气的声音传来！
“这……这是……”叶傅声音发颤。
“我的天！”
“真是叶弑天的宝藏啊！”
叶镇东、叶镇西、叶镇南三兄弟，眼珠子几乎瞪出来！
“我们叶家后山，居然埋着这种宝藏？！”
叶薇妮捂住嘴巴，不敢置信地看向叶凡。
突然。
一道身影发疯一样冲进宝物堆里。
叶辰像一条疯狗，拼命把丹药、灵石往怀里塞：“哈哈哈哈！果然！叶凡啊叶凡！我就知道你是个废物！”
“没有这些宝库里的东西，你他妈哪来的今天？”
“我就知道！我就知道你不如我，我叶辰要是有这些宝物，你叶凡算个屁啊！”
content_en:
Above the dry well.
"Damn it, we rushed to Dongtu for days and nights in a row, and now they are getting the treasure down below, and we are drinking the northwest wind above." A bearded man cursed and angrily thrust a knife into the ground: "I am very angry now!"
Another man with a Chinese character face said amusedly: "I am a martial artist, so I am definitely qualified to enter."
"We just take the fixed offerings, and it's good to eat some."
The bearded man stood up and glanced at the group of female members of the Ye family: "I have nothing to do anyway, I'll vent my anger first..."
Eyes locked on Ye Weini!
She is tall, fair-skinned, has a plump body, and a pretty face that is not inferior to that of a brothel oiran.
It must be comfortable to insert!
Ye Weini subconsciously hid behind Ye Fu.
Ye Fu stood in front with a cane and said in a hoarse voice, "What do you want to do?"
"Get away!"
The bearded man grabbed Ye Fu's shoulders and threw him out.
"Grandpa!"
Ye Weini wanted to go over and help her, but the bearded man grabbed her shoulder and was about to do something inappropriate.
A cold voice came from behind: "What are you doing?"
The bearded man was excited, looked back, and immediately showed a flattering smile: "Mr. Zhang, it's you, why are you here?"
Mr. Zhang said coldly: "Second Master has an order! There are too many things down there, so I want you all to go down and move them together!"
"People from the Ye family, prevent them from escaping and bring them in together!"
The eleven Wu Zong were immediately overjoyed.
"Hahaha! I said the second master will never forget us!"
"Quick! Quick!"
The bearded man suppressed the evil fire and led more than a hundred people from the Ye family to jump into the dry well.
When everyone in the Ye family passed through the stone gate and saw the true face inside the treasure house, everyone stood there in shock.
Countless elixirs, spiritual stones, enchanted weapons, Warcraft crystal cores, and various levels of martial arts are dazzling.
"Hiss——!"
There was a sound of gasping!
"This...this is..." Ye Fu's voice trembled.
"Oh my God!"
"It's really Ye Shitian's treasure!"
The eyes of the three brothers Ye Zhendong, Ye Zhenxi and Ye Zhennan almost bulged out!
"There is such a treasure buried in the back of our Ye family?!"
Ye Weini covered her mouth and looked at Mark in disbelief.
Sudden.
A figure rushed into the treasure pile like crazy.
Ye Chen was like a mad dog, desperately stuffing pills and spiritual stones into his arms: "Hahahaha! Sure enough! Ye Fan, Ye Fan! I knew you were a waste!"
"Without these treasures, where the hell would you be today?"
"I knew it! I knew you were not as good as me. If I, Ye Chen, had these treasures, you, Ye Fan, would be nothing!"
